title: Custom API / Backend Service Database Access
summary: 研究 Supabase Edge Function 作為 trusted backend service 時的資料庫存取與 transaction boundary。Phase A Access、Phase B Operation、Phase C Transaction 已完成 runtime verification：object privilege / RLS、Function EXECUTE 與 atomic RPC transaction 可形成不同層級的治理邊界；separate Data API requests 無法 rollback 已完成的前一個 request，而 one RPC operation 可在 DB failure 或 Business Logic abort 時完整 rollback。Phase D 將驗證 Backend Service caller-owned transaction feasibility。
flow: Phase A VERIFIED: access boundary via PostgreSQL object privilege / RLS. Phase B VERIFIED: approved Function EXECUTE can be separated from direct table UPDATE. Phase C VERIFIED: separate Data API requests leave partial state on later failure; one RPC operation commits or rolls back the complete database operation, including explicit Business Logic exception. Phase D PLANNED: test whether Edge Function can own a direct PostgreSQL session transaction and evaluate its operational/security cost.
